    UseThisAbility _ (isSource attrs -> True) 1 -> do
      deck <- unDeck <$> getEncounterDeck
      (others, rest) <- breakM (pure . (`cardMatch` card_ #enemy)) deck
      case rest of
        -- No enemy in the deck; leave the deck as revealed (nothing to spawn).
        -- TODO: if the encounter deck is exhausted without an enemy, the discard
        -- should be shuffled in and revealing continued.
        [] -> pure ()
        (enemyCard : remaining) -> do
          -- Shuffle each other revealed card and place them on top of the deck.
          shuffledOthers <- shuffleM others
          setEncounterDeck $ Deck (shuffledOthers <> remaining)
          createEnemyWith_ enemyCard (SpawnAtLocationMatching $ FirstLocation [EmptyLocation, Anywhere]) id
      pure a
    -- Chronicle scenario-fixes: revealing does not remove cards from the deck.
    -- Scan it once, including the no-enemy case, and shuffle every other
    -- revealed card. An empty starting deck is refilled before this effect.
    UseThisAbility _ (isSource attrs -> True) 1 -> do
      deck <- unDeck <$> getEncounterDeck
      when (null deck) $ push ShuffleEncounterDiscardBackIn
      doStep 1 msg
      pure a
    DoStep 1 ability@(UseThisAbility _ (isSource attrs -> True) 1) -> do
      deck <- unDeck <$> getEncounterDeck
      let (others, rest) = break (`cardMatch` card_ #enemy) deck
      shuffledOthers <- shuffleM others
      case rest of
        [] -> setEncounterDeck $ Deck shuffledOthers
        enemyCard : remaining -> do
          let completedDeck = shuffledOthers <> remaining
          setEncounterDeck $ Deck completedDeck
          createEnemyWith_ enemyCard (SpawnAtLocationMatching $ FirstLocation [EmptyLocation, Anywhere]) id
          -- Only removing the sole card can actually empty this deck. Finish
          -- spawning before its exhaustion window and discard reshuffle.
          when (null completedDeck) $ doStep 2 ability
      pure a
    DoStep 2 (UseThisAbility _ (isSource attrs -> True) 1) -> do
      deck <- unDeck <$> getEncounterDeck
      when (null deck) do
        checkWhen Window.EncounterDeckRunsOutOfCards
        push ShuffleEncounterDiscardBackIn
      pure a

    FailedThisSkillTestBy iid (isSource attrs -> True) n | n > 0 -> do
      cultists <- selectCount $ #cultist <> EnemyWithoutDoom <> CanPlaceDoomOnEnemy
      if cultists > 0
        then doStep n msg
        else findAndDrawEncounterCard iid $ #enemy <> CardWithTrait Cultist
      pure t
    DoStep n msg'@(FailedThisSkillTest iid (isSource attrs -> True)) | n > 0 -> do
      cultists <- select $ #cultist <> EnemyWithoutDoom <> CanPlaceDoomOnEnemy
      chooseTargetM iid cultists \cultist -> do
        placeDoom attrs cultist 1
        doStep (n - 1) msg'
      pure t
      revelationSkillTest sid iid attrs #willpower (Fixed 3)
      pure $ BlasphemousInvocation $ attrs & setMeta False
    -- Chronicle scenario-fixes: track actual placements, not eligible targets
    -- or pending attempts. Brethren of Ash can replace every doom with damage.
    CheckWindows ws
      | any (\case
          Window.Window Timing.After (Window.PlacedDoom (isSource attrs -> True) _ n) _ _ -> n > 0
          _ -> False) ws ->
          pure $ BlasphemousInvocation $ attrs & setMeta True
    FailedThisSkillTestBy _ (isSource attrs -> True) n -> do
      doStep (max 0 n) msg
      pure t
    DoStep n msg'@(FailedThisSkillTest iid (isSource attrs -> True)) | n > 0 -> do
      cultists <- select $ #cultist <> EnemyWithoutDoom <> CanPlaceDoomOnEnemy
      if null cultists
        then doStep 0 msg'
        else chooseTargetM iid cultists \cultist -> do
          placeDoom attrs cultist 1
          doStep (n - 1) msg'
      pure t
    DoStep 0 (FailedThisSkillTest iid (isSource attrs -> True)) -> do
      unless (toResultDefault False attrs.meta)
        $ findAndDrawEncounterCard iid
        $ #enemy <> CardWithTrait Cultist
      pure t

    Matcher.PlacedDoomCounter timing sourceMatcher targetMatcher -> guardTiming timing $ \case
      Window.PlacedDoom source' target _ ->
        andM [targetMatches target targetMatcher, sourceMatches source' sourceMatcher]
      _ -> noMatch
    Matcher.PlacedDoomCounter timing sourceMatcher targetMatcher -> guardTiming timing $ \case
      -- Chronicle scenario-fixes: no counters placed means no placement trigger.
      Window.PlacedDoom source' target n | n > 0 ->
        andM [targetMatches target targetMatcher, sourceMatches source' sourceMatcher]
      _ -> noMatch
